sentences.en: As expected, an album was hastily compiled, titled My Cherie Amour and released in August 1969.
sentences.vi: Đúng như dự đoán, một album được biên soạn gấp rút, mang tên My Cherie Amour và phát hành vào tháng 8 năm 1969.

sentences.en: Labor has defended Cherie Blair over a £ 7,700 bill for a personal hair stylist during the last election campaign.

sentences.en: Cherie seems some time ago to have decided that slogging away in the courts would not solve her problems.
